text:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for alder-compact-6b (int8) into the embed catalog. Did a first pass semantic-sim recall@1/5/10 vs our heron-v3 baseline on wiki-short and wiki-long splits. Short queries (<=8 tokens) show an absolute drop at recall@10 ~2.4%. Sharing quick snippets and next steps.
aj: can you paste the exact numbers and the eval command you used? curious whether it's quantization artifact or eval config mismatch.
maria: results snippet:
```
Model: alder-compact-6b-int8
Dataset: wiki-short (5k)
Recall@1: baseline 0.612 -> alder 0.595 (-0.017)
Recall@5: 0.798 -> 0.784 (-0.014)
Recall@10: 0.865 -> 0.841 (-0.024)
```
script: evals/embed_recall_v2.py --nprobe 16 --metric cosine --seed 42
Also ran cluster purity quickcheck: silhouette (cosine) dropped from 0.41 -> 0.38 on short split. Long queries look within noise (+0.005).
luca: is this global int8 or per-channel? small short-query regressions often track per-channel quant.
maria: global symmetric int8 via ONNX PTQ for this run. No per-channel yet. planning to try per-channel and clamp ranges next. Tried a quick reranking threshold tweak (inference-side) — negligible improvement.
david: can you surface token-length distribution for the failing subset? might be truncation/padding mismatch or embedding pooling differences for very short contexts.
maria: attached quick hist: short split median = 6 tokens, tail very short (1-2). Also using avg-pooling window=last-8 by default. batch_size for embed job was 64, CPU postproc.
aj: also try hybrid int8 (int8 weights + float16 activations) — we've seen this restore recall in other compact models. and run a smaller baseline with the same batching/padding to rule out eval variance.
maria: good call — kicking hybrid run now. adding per-channel PTQ after that.
ci-bot: ci-bot: queued job alder-int8-hybrid-recall (job id 61234) — params: per_channel=false, hybrid_activations=true, dataset=wiki-short. Link: https://ci/redwood/61234
luca: if hybrid gives >1% back, we can ship int8 with hybrid-activation profile and set fallback to fp16 for top-k mismatch. also add prefix-cache experiment — short queries are frequently repeated.
maria: noted. I'll run prefix-cache + hybrid in the next matrix. if hybrid restores, plan: canary 5% traffic on dedicated pool, monitor recall@k via eval webhook plus latency SLO. will update onboarding doc with quant knobs and the rollback/homeostasis thresholds.
david: add cluster-quality test to the rollout checklist — run HDBSCAN on a sample and check for singleton explosion / very low cluster density. if silhouette < 0.35 on short split, block rollout.
maria: added to checklist. i'll post final numbers and a short blurb for the README once jobs finish. :thumbsup:
